title.en: Dylan Field live at Figma's Config: Intuition, simplicity, and the future of design
title.zh: Dylan Field在Figma Config上的现场演讲：直觉、简洁性与设计的未来

summary.en: In this conversation, Dylan Field shares the story of building Figma from a fledgling browser-based design tool into a category-defining product used across the industry. He discusses why treating design as a first-class, collaborative discipline—rather than a handoff—was core to Figma's differentiation and growth. Dylan also digs into lessons on product taste, hiring elite small teams, and why staying patient and focused on craft ultimately beat chasing every market opportunity.
summary.zh: 在这期对话中，Dylan Field 讲述了如何将 Figma 从一个浏览器端的初创设计工具，打造成被全行业使用的标杆性产品。他谈到，把设计当作一项一等公民、可协作的学科（而非交付环节）是 Figma 实现差异化与增长的核心。Dylan 还深入分享了关于产品品味、组建精悍精英团队的经验，以及为何保持耐心、专注工艺最终胜过追逐每一个市场机会。
